_readme: Measured values only. Every entry is reproducible by the command in `how`. Never hand-edit a number that was not actually observed.

success_metric.name: validated_out_of_sample_performance_and_reliability
success_metric.why: There is no predictive model in this project, so out-of-sample predictive performance has no baseline and cannot be measured. See TENSIONS.md T-1. Reliability is tracked below via test coverage, gate pass rate, and build health.

measurements.note: First baseline. Values observed, not estimated.

reliability.how: cd backend && ruff check . && pytest ; cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build

performance.note: Initial bundle was 728000 bytes before the chart was split out; that is the only historical point available.

size.how: find backend/app -name '*.py' | xargs wc -l ; find frontend/src -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' | xargs wc -l

data_integrity.note: Stock screener (Phase 11) is reported unavailable because FMP returns HTTP 402 on the free tier.
